Same league, date, home and away team appearing twice would double-count a match.

Each match labelled fans / ghost / fans_back. Restart per league = first match after the longest pause in 2019/20 (found in the data, not typed). 2020/21 counted as ghost (no or very limited crowds); strict_ghost marks only the 2019/20 post-restart matches for a robustness check.
The card model uses log(fouls) as an offset (cards per foul); log(0) is undefined. Team-match rows with zero recorded fouls are dropped from the card model only.
